channel.title: Japan AI Monitor
channel.description: AI monitoring of Japan's political, economic and security developments

item.title: Japan not immune to public backlash against data centers, experts say
item.description: Last week's U.S. midterm congressional elections have highlighted just how strong opposition to data center construction has become.

item.title: 16 Japanese detained in Laos for suspected scam involvement
item.description: The incident is part of a series of crackdowns on Japanese nationals suspected involvement in such schemes in the Southeast Asian country.

item.title: Honda raises outlook even as failed EV bet weighs on profit
item.description: The carmaker now expects an operating profit of ¥780 billion in the fiscal year ending March 2027, up from its previous guidance of ¥650 billion.

item.title: Tokyo court dismisses suit against Meta over fake ads involving entrepreneur
item.description: The ruling is believed to be the first judicial decision on whether fake ads impersonating celebrities infringe on their rights.

item.title: Swiss franc, Japanese yen Rise as DeepSeek News Boosts Safe Havens
item.description: The Yen and Swiss Franc were stronger against the dollar as investors sought safe havens after Chinese start-up DeepSeek’s new AI model hit U.S. tech stocks.
